source.title: Aircraft Characteristics Data, October 2024
source.licence: US Government work (FAA, 17 U.S.C. 105), public domain

ICAO_Code.text: International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Aircraft Type Designator | Not Applicable | Standard abbreviations for aircraft assigned by ICAO that are most commonly used by air traffic services. | ICAO Website | https://www.icao.int/publications/doc8643/pages/search.aspx

FAA_Designator.text: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Aircraft Type Designator | Not Applicable | Standard abbreviations for aircraft assigned by FAA that are most commonly used by air traffic services. | FAA Order JO 7360.1G | https://www.faa.gov/regulations_policies/orders_notices/index.cfm/go/document.information/documentID/1040874

Wingspan_ft_without_winglets_sharklets.text: Aircraft Wingspan applicable for those models without winglets or sharklets | Feet | Wingspan is measured from tip to tip. | Aircraft Manufacturer Manual

Wingspan_ft_with_winglets_sharklets.text: Aircraft Wingspan applicable for those models with winglets or sharklets | Feet | Wingspan is measured from tip to tip. | Aircraft Manufacturer Manual

Length_ft.text: Aircraft Full Length | Feet | Aircraft Manufacturer Manual

Tail_Height_at_OEW_ft.text: Aircraft Tail Height at Operating Empty Weight (OEW) | Feet | OEW is the operating empty weight of an aircraft including the crew, all fluids necessary for operation such as engine oil but excluding fuel and no payload. | Aircraft Manufacturer Manual

MTOW_lb.text: Maximum Takeoff Gross Weight (MTOW) | lbs | Aircraft Manufacturer Manual

_meta.units: ft and lb as published in the ACD (in "acd"); m = ft x 0.3048, kg = lb x 0.45359237 (exact factors), rounded to 1 mm and 0.1 kg
_meta.type_list: hwd3d/refs/cache/adsb/hwd_mix_summary.txt line "TYPE MIX (on airfield)" (truncated to 60 entries) + recount: recount over 111 recording files: 243 on-field aircraft (Phase 0: 243), 90 distinct type strings, 38 without type; counts of listed types that differ from the summary: none
_meta.privacy: type designators and aircraft counts only (default D1)

src_legend.obs: dimensions read from the FAA ACD row named in "source"
src_legend.null: no FAA ACD row for this designator: dimensions are null, not guessed (see "note")

_meta.licence: Mixed: the dimensions (FAA ACD) are a U.S. Government work in the public domain; the on-field counts (onfield_aircraft, note_count) are derived from adsb.lol data, made available under the Open Database License 1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/), so this file is offered under the ODbL 1.0
